{{DISPLAYTITLE:ML_MOPOT_RM}}
{{TAGDEF|ML_MOPOT_RM|[real]|1.0}}

Description: Specifies the equilibrium bond distance of the Morse potentials used as auxiliary potentials in thermodynamic integration ({{TAG|VCAIMAGES}}).
----
This parameter sets the equilibrium bond distance <math>r_{e}</math> of the following Morse potential

<math>
V(r) = D_e (1-e^{-\beta(r-r_{e})})^2 - 1.
</math>
